description: Source code for trigger shape and trigger shape initialization in the rusEfi engine, including classes TriggerShape and trigger_shape_helper, with functions for configuring trigger shapes, adding trigger events, and calculating trigger positions.

classes.name: trigger_shape_helper
classes.description: Helper class for managing trigger shape pin states and channels.

classes.name: TriggerShape
